summary: Applied Digital Corp. filed an 8-K/A to disclose the release of escrow funds for its subsidiary's 6.75% Senior Secured Notes due 2031. On March 10, 2026, the issuer completed a private offering, with gross proceeds held in escrow pending satisfaction of the ESA Condition. On June 17, 2026, the condition was met, and funds were released to the issuer for use per the escrow and indenture agreements. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation; no activist, strategic review, or structural change is involved. No deal terms are applicable.
